findings.summary: A metadata-only READY descendant remained canonically contradictory because PROJECT_TRUTH, FOUNDATION_INDEX, PROJECT_PHASES and AGENTS still asserted permanent REVIEW_REQUIRED status outside the lifecycle allowlist.
Package/schema/source semantics, semantic lock, temporal/source binding, lineage, alternatives, replay, route, correction and withdrawal behavior remain intact.
Round-10 READY artifacts and protected #329/#330, Gate C, project state, runtime, frontend and data scopes remain immutable.
